summary: @servicetitan/microfront-auth preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/*.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run the sibling `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` obfuscated with a rotating string-array scheme and mangled `_0xNNNN` identifiers. The executed payload is unrelated to the library's advertised microfrontend authentication functionality (the real MobX/axios token-exchange code sits in `dist/*.js` and never references `math_init.js`), and no native source or build system is present that would justify fetching an alternate runtime. `setup.mjs` itself is also identifier-mangled. The package publishes under the `@servicetitan` npm scope with `repository.url` pointing at `github.com/servicetitan/playground.git`, impersonating ServiceTitan's public GitHub organization to lend credibility to the tarball. Installing the package on default `npm install` causes the obfuscated payload to execute on the installer host under a freshly-fetched Bun interpreter, giving the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
